PlayerKarteaConfigEditView

class PlayerKarteaConfigEditView(parent=None, editing=False)[source]

Bases: QDialog, Ui_PlayerKarteaConfigEditView, WindowConfig

Modal dialog to create or edit a player Kartea config.

Loads the UI from the .ui file, applies consistent styling (icons, size, title), and delegates all validation and data handling to PlayerKarteaConfigEditController. The view does not create its controller: KarteaViewFactory creates both and calls bind(controller) to connect the signals. The controller only uses the methods below; it never touches widgets.

Parameters:
parentQWidget | None, optional

Parent widget.

editingbool, optional

True when editing an existing config (title “Editar”); False when creating a new one (“Novo”). Defaults to False.

Attributes:
RESOURCE_COMBOSdict[str, str], class attribute

Form field -> name of its resource (image/sound) combo box, built from KarteaResourceFields.ALL.

PREVIEW_COMBOSdict[str, tuple[str, str, bool]], class attribute

Image combo -> (field, type shown in the preview, is feedback?). Feedback images use the feedback tab preview; the others, the Visual Resource tab preview.

SOUND_COMBOStuple[tuple[str, str, str], …], class attribute

(field, sound combo, button that plays the sound).

OPEN_MODS_BUTTONSdict[str, str], class attribute

“Open resources folder” button of each tab -> mods subfolder it opens.

controllerPlayerKarteaConfigEditController | None

Handles field initialization, validation, and data extraction; None until bind is called.

sound_effectsdict[str, QSoundEffect]

Preloaded sound of each sound combo, created by bind.

update_resource_preview(…) / update_feedback_preview(…)

Show an image preview in the visual resource or feedback tab.

Notes

The widgets (cbx_*, spn_*, chk_*, pb_*, lbl_*) come from the generated Ui_PlayerKarteaConfigEditView (setupUi).

The arrival time spin boxes keep their ranges consistent: each speed must be faster than the previous one (see KarteaArrivalTimeFields). The feet click time is enabled only while feet click is checked.

Localized texts (title, preview labels, messages) are translated with self.tr(). The palette names/descriptions and the preview labels are QT_TRANSLATE_NOOP source texts of KarteaPalettes and KarteaResourceFields in this class context (“PlayerKarteaConfigEditView”) (i18n).

bind(controller)[source]

Connect the widgets’ signals to the controller.

Called by KarteaViewFactory after the controller has filled the form, so the initial filling does not trigger previews; the sounds already selected are preloaded here.

Parameters:
controllerPlayerKarteaConfigEditController

Controller of this view.

Notes

Also connects the “Open resources folder” buttons (a screen-only action), the phase combo (reloads the levels through the controller), the image previews (on selection change and on focus) and creates sound_effects.

set_form_data(data)[source]

Fill the form.

Parameters:
datadict[str, Any]

Same keys as get_form_data.

Notes

The levels of the phase must have been loaded before (set_level_choices). Arrival times are ordered and clamped (KarteaArrivalTimeFields.order); an unknown palette falls back to the default one; a missing feet click time becomes 1.2 s.

player_id, session_id, phase_id, level_id and the config fields. Arrival times are returned already ordered by KarteaArrivalTimeFields.order.
